lyrics:
“In my arms, She was

One for the loss

Aiming the reasons

I need it once

I might not find what I lost

I pursue no pleasure

Nothing was a choice 

No thing was a choice

It’s all a picture now

And it’s clearer everyday

I still Seek

I still See"
